name: Gem of False Dreams
description: A strange gem of unknown origins. Grants the holder unimaginable power when used.

name: Vial of Dragonblood
description: A vial of blood obtained from a dragon. Only the brave or foolish dare to drink it.

name: Blood Crystal
description: A crimson crystal in the shape of a heart. Can be used to replace one's own heart.

name: Shadow Crystal
description: A shard of black glass. Looking through it reveals the truth of the world.

name: Phylactery Core
description: A soul-bound core required to transcend mortality. Consumed when acquiring the Lich class.
